title: Interaction
description: One complete record of a single Henry <-> Assistant Agent interaction. This is the core Data Ownership unit (Pilot Step 5): every real interaction, regardless of outcome, produces exactly one of these records, stored on Henry's own machine (SQLite in data/pilot.db), independent of Discord and independent of Claude as a provider.

id.description: Stable unique id for this interaction (e.g. interaction-<uuid>).

created_at.description: When the raw input was received (UTC, ISO 8601).

source.description: Channel/transport the input arrived through, e.g. 'discord', 'cli'. Never hardcode logic elsewhere against this value beyond routing.

channel_ref.description: Transport-specific reference (e.g. Discord channel id / DM id), opaque to the Agent's domain logic.

raw_input.description: Henry's original input, verbatim, before any processing.

action_type.description: The Agent's own initial classification. Action Type and Domain are separate dimensions (Pilot Step 4) -- this field never encodes domain.

domain.description: Free-text domain label if determinable from content (e.g. 'Food R&D', 'Business & Strategy'). Null when not determinable -- never fabricated to force a value. Deliberately free text, not an enum: Pilot v1 does not pre-commit to a fixed domain taxonomy (that is exactly the kind of premature framework-expansion this Pilot exists to avoid).

agent_response.description: What the Agent actually said/did back to Henry. Null only if no response was produced (e.g. logging-only path).

model_used.description: Model identifier actually invoked for this interaction (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-5'). Null if no model call was made (pure rule/deterministic path).

input_tokens.description: Input tokens for this invocation, if the provider made this available. Null, never fabricated, when unavailable.

output_tokens.description: Output tokens for this invocation, if available. Null when unavailable.

latency_ms.description: Wall-clock time for the model invocation, if easily measurable.

estimated_cost_usd.description: Best-effort cost estimate from provider-published pricing, if input/output tokens are known. Null when not computable -- never guessed.

purpose.description: Why this particular model call was made (e.g. 'intake_classification', 'general_ai_task_response'). Used later to decide which purposes can move to deterministic rules or a smaller model (Pilot Step 6).

tool_executions.description: Any concrete tool/action executions performed while handling this interaction (e.g. a calendar write, a file edit). Empty array, not omitted, when none occurred.

summary.description: Short, human-readable description of what was executed -- not a full transcript.

henry_correction.description: What Henry said/did to correct the Agent's classification or response, verbatim, if he did. Null when no correction occurred -- absence of correction is itself meaningful signal, not a gap to fill in.

final_action_type.description: Action Type after Henry's correction, if any. Null means 'same as action_type' (no correction) -- kept separate from action_type so the original AI guess is never overwritten/lost.

final_domain.description: Domain after Henry's correction, if any. Null means 'same as domain' (no correction).

task_status.description: Current status of whatever this interaction represents. 'unknown' is a legitimate, honest value -- never defaulted to 'done'.

related_interaction_id.description: id of a related earlier interaction (e.g. this is the follow-up this Reminder was about). Null when there is no known relation.

closure_outcome.description: What actually happened when this was closed (plain text). Null while still open/unknown.

closed_at.description: When task_status transitioned to 'done' or 'cancelled'. Null while not closed.

due_at.description: When this item is actually due/relevant (deadline, reminder time, or calendar time), if Henry stated or clearly implied one. Null when not determinable -- never invented (Henry's Functional Spec v1.0 SS4.2: do not fabricate a deadline he did not give). Powers the 08:15 Morning Brief / 22:00 Daily Close; a suggested-but-unconfirmed date must stay out of this field until Henry confirms it.
